description: Defines classes for handling flexible O-DU metrics, including log, JSON, and STDOUT consumers, with methods for handling metrics, enabling/disabling output, and printing headers.

classes.name: flexible_o_du_metrics_consumer_log
classes.description: Logs flexible O-DU metrics to a specified log channel, handling metrics and managing internal handlers.

classes.name: flexible_o_du_metrics_consumer_json
classes.description: Outputs flexible O-DU metrics in JSON format via a remote server gateway.

classes.name: ru_metrics_consumer_stdout
classes.description: Outputs RU metrics to STDOUT, with controls for enabling/disabling and printing headers.

methods.name: handle_metric
methods.description: Processes a metrics set; overridden in each consumer class.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables metrics output in STDOUT consumer.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables metrics output in STDOUT consumer.

methods.name: print_header
methods.description: Prints header for metrics output in STDOUT consumer.
